gaps.lead: Pay claims must be submitted before the end of the month.
gaps.sentence: You have ___ your pay claims before the end of the month.
gaps.explanation: 'Must be submitted' becomes 'you have to put in your claims'.

gaps.lead: It was a mistake not to write the telephone number down.
gaps.sentence: I should ___ writing down the telephone number.
gaps.hint: make a point of doing = be sure to do
gaps.explanation: Regret about an omitted action: 'should have made a point of writing it down'.

gaps.lead: He spoke slowly because he wanted us to understand him.
gaps.explanation: so that + subject + would/could expresses purpose.

gaps.lead: We packed a spare tyre because the road might be bad.
gaps.sentence: We packed a spare tyre ___ bad.
gaps.hint: in case = because it might happen
gaps.explanation: in case + clause = as a precaution against a possibility.

gaps.lead: The doctor persuaded me to promise that I would exercise daily.
gaps.sentence: The doctor ___ that I would exercise daily.
gaps.explanation: get somebody TO do something = persuade/make them.
